scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem is a three-dimensional finite-direction consequence of the one-direction curvature-symmetry theorem. It identifies the minimum number of prescribed directional tests but does not classify all sufficient triples or claim a higher-dimensional analogue. The proof independently checks the reflection-group mechanism and supplies a smooth strictly convex spheroidal counterexample for every prescribed pair of directions.
title: Three curvature-order directions are sharp for spherical rigidity
